title.en: OpenAI chief scientist proposes perplexity as shared yardstick for AI progress
title.zh: OpenAI首席科学家提议以困惑度作为衡量AI进展的通用标尺

summary.en: In a Nov. 22 post, Jakub Pachocki argued that perplexity should be a cross-industry metric for comparing models and anchoring shared safety limits, and published OpenAI's internal pretraining measurements.
summary.zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki于11月22日发文，主张把“困惑度”作为业界比较模型、制定共同安全限制的统一指标，并公开了OpenAI内部的预训练测量数据。

body.en:
Pachocki writes that benchmarks of downstream capabilities go stale quickly, while perplexity — how well a model predicts the next token — has stayed informative. He says publishing OpenAI's numbers gives competitors a clearer view of where it stands, but that this is outweighed by the urgency of shared safety measures ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/perplexity-and-intelligence/)).

According to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/22/openais-chief-scientist-has-thoughts-on-how-to-limit-ai-development/), the post includes a chart of OpenAI's falling perplexity since GPT-3.5: GPT-4 sat at about 0.91, and losses below 0.8 coincided with transformative capabilities in areas such as cybersecurity and mathematics. Sam Altman called it "the most important thing OpenAI has published in a while." The post follows Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for companies to agree on limits to the rate of unchecked AI progress.
body.zh:
Pachocki认为，衡量下游能力的基准测试很快就会过时，而衡量模型预测下一个词元能力的困惑度一直具有参考价值。他表示，公开OpenAI的数据会让竞争对手更清楚其所处位置，但建立共同安全措施的紧迫性更重要（[OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/perplexity-and-intelligence/)）。

据[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/22/openais-chief-scientist-has-thoughts-on-how-to-limit-ai-development/)报道，文中图表显示自GPT-3.5以来OpenAI模型的困惑度持续下降：GPT-4约为0.91，损失降到0.8以下时，模型在网络安全、数学等领域出现了变革性能力。奥特曼称这是OpenAI“近来发布的最重要的东西”。此前Anthropic首席执行官阿莫代伊呼吁各公司就限制AI无节制发展的速度达成一致。

title.zh: 重庆出台词元驱动数据产业措施，鼓励建立词元计量计价规则
title.en: Chongqing backs token-driven data industry, urges token metering and pricing rules

summary.zh: 国家数据局11月22日转发重庆《促进词元驱动的数据产业高质量发展若干措施》，提出探索词元交易、建立词元计量与计价规则、支持词元出海；国家层面的词元计量等标准也在研制中。
summary.en: China's data administration on Nov. 22 republished Chongqing measures to explore token trading, set token metering and pricing rules and support token exports, as national token standards are being drafted.

body.zh:
据[国家数据局](https://www.nda.gov.cn/sjj/swdt/dfdt/1122/20261122102028613559124_pc.html)转发的文件，措施由重庆市大数据应用发展管理局和市财政局印发，提出培育“按效分配、按用付费”的词元市场机制，鼓励数据流通服务机构建立词元计量与计价规则，支持企业开展词元出海业务；对达到国内领先水平的数据基础设施项目，按研发投入的30%给予最高100万元补贴。

在国家层面，国家数据发展研究院已牵头启动《词元 生产与运营服务质量规范》《词元工厂评价通则》等标准研制，并参与《词元 计量规范》等标准，针对计量口径不一、计费不透明等问题（[搜狐转国家数据局](https://www.sohu.com/a/1103307063_121106994)）。

title.en: COP31 in Antalya ends without a climate pact after fossil-fuel deadlock
title.zh: 安塔利亚COP31因化石燃料分歧未能达成气候协议

summary.en: The UN climate summit in Türkiye closed Sunday after two days of overtime without an overarching outcome. Guterres called it deeply disappointing: "There may be no consensus in the negotiating room. There is no ambiguity in the science."
summary.zh: 在土耳其举行的联合国气候大会加时两天后于周日闭幕，未能达成总体成果。古特雷斯表示“深感失望”，称“谈判室里或许没有共识，但科学没有任何含糊”。

body.en:
According to [UN News](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168855), disagreement over fossil-fuel language was the main obstacle, and several countries formally objected to the final text as weakening earlier commitments. Antalya became the longest-running UN climate summit on record.

Web reports from [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/3fec1b0a85a0/sustainability/cop/cop31-climate-talks-close-final-deal-says-summit-president-2026-11-21/) and [AP](https://apnews.com/article/climate-un-turkey-fossil-fuels-global-warming-f6e36c4caf13ec6fed57c9f077cbd067) say the draft omitted any reference to transitioning away from fossil fuels; the EU, Panama, the Marshall Islands and others rejected it, while oil producers including Saudi Arabia and Russia opposed such language. Rows over climate finance and carbon capture also contributed.
body.zh:
据[联合国新闻](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168855)，化石燃料相关表述的分歧是主要障碍，多国正式反对最终文本，认为其削弱了此前承诺。安塔利亚会议成为有记录以来历时最长的联合国气候大会。

据[路透社](https://www.reuters.com/3fec1b0a85a0/sustainability/cop/cop31-climate-talks-close-final-deal-says-summit-president-2026-11-21/)和[美联社](https://apnews.com/article/climate-un-turkey-fossil-fuels-global-warming-f6e36c4caf13ec6fed57c9f077cbd067)报道，草案未提及摆脱化石燃料，欧盟、巴拿马、马绍尔群岛等方面拒绝接受，沙特、俄罗斯等产油国则反对此类表述。气候资金和碳捕集问题上的争执也是原因。

title.en: Iran says two supertankers hit naval mines near Hormuz; rolling blackouts begin at home
title.zh: 伊朗称两艘超级油轮在霍尔木兹附近触雷，国内开始轮流停电

summary.en: Iran's IRGC Navy said two unnamed supertankers struck mines north of Ghanam Island and east of the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday after using "unauthorized routes." It gave no casualty or damage details.
summary.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军周日称，两艘未具名超级油轮在加纳姆岛以北及霍尔木兹海峡以东“未经许可的航线”上触雷，发生爆炸并停航，未公布伤亡和损失情况。

body.en:
[Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-says-2-supertankers-struck-naval-mines-near-strait-of-hormuz/4133736), citing Fars, reports the IRGC said the strait is "fully under the control and surveillance" of its forces and urged shipowners to avoid routes it has declared unauthorized. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611224393) says the navy claimed the tankers had switched off identification and navigation systems.

At home, Iran began rolling power cuts on Nov. 22 because of fuel shortages at power plants — about two hours every other day, possibly daily as it gets colder. President Pezeshkian said US and Israeli strikes on gas infrastructure have worsened the crunch ([The Straits Times/AFP](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/iran-to-ration-electricity-as-war-hits-energy-network)).
body.zh:
[阿纳多卢通讯社](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-says-2-supertankers-struck-naval-mines-near-strait-of-hormuz/4133736)援引法尔斯通讯社报道，革命卫队称海峡“完全处于其控制和监视之下”，敦促船东避开其宣布的未许可航线。[伊朗国际](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611224393)称，伊朗海军说两船关闭了识别和导航系统。

国内方面，因电厂燃料短缺，伊朗自11月22日起实行轮流停电，约每两天停电两小时，天气转冷后部分地区可能每天停电。总统佩泽希齐扬称美以对天然气设施的打击加剧了能源紧张（[《海峡时报》/法新社](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/iran-to-ration-electricity-as-war-hits-energy-network)）。

title.zh: 特朗普称寻求与伊朗达成“永久性”协议
title.en: Trump says he will seek a 'permanent' deal with Iran

summary.zh: 特朗普在福克斯新闻21日播出的采访中称，将寻求与伊朗达成永久性协议，确保日后即使换了总统也不会让伊朗拥核或推翻协议；他还称未考虑伊朗政权更迭。
summary.en: In a Fox News interview aired on the 21st, Trump said he would seek a permanent Iran deal that future presidents could not undo to let Iran get nuclear weapons, adding he was not considering regime change.

title.en: South Korea readies market stabilization fund to head off a 'Black Monday'
title.zh: 韩国准备启动股市稳定基金，防范“黑色星期一”

summary.en: After KOSPI fell below 5,000 amid a global AI-stock selloff, Seoul's economic and financial chiefs met Sunday, readied the stabilization fund for immediate use, eased buyback limits and launched a crackdown on illegal short selling.
summary.zh: 在全球AI股抛售中韩国综合指数跌破5000点后，韩国经济金融首长周日召开紧急会议，准备随时动用股市稳定基金，放宽上市公司回购限制，并严打非法卖空。

body.en:
Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lee Hyeong-il chaired the emergency "F4" meeting with the central bank and financial regulators. Daily buyback order limits for listed companies will be eased for three months from Tuesday, and a capital-market reform task force will launch without delay ([The Herald Business](https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10945209)).

[SBS](https://news.sbs.co.kr/english/article.do?news_id=N1008857914) reports officials blamed rising uncertainty around the global AI and semiconductor industries after the three main New York indexes fell together on Friday.
body.zh:
副总理兼企划财政部长李亨一主持了有央行和金融监管机构参加的“F4”紧急会议。上市公司每日回购委托限额将自周二起放宽三个月，资本市场改革工作组也将立即启动（[Herald Business](https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10945209)）。

据[SBS](https://news.sbs.co.kr/english/article.do?news_id=N1008857914)报道，官员认为，上周五纽约三大股指同步下跌后，全球AI与半导体行业的不确定性上升，加剧了市场波动。

title.en: Wall Street enters Thanksgiving week in correction, eyes inflation data
title.zh: 美股带着回调进入感恩节周，关注通胀数据

summary.en: After Friday's AI washout pushed the Dow and S&P 500 into correction and sent the VIX above 30, investors face a holiday-shortened week with inflation data that could sway fears of a Fed hike at its Dec. 9 meeting.
summary.zh: 上周五AI股大跌使道指和标普500指数进入回调区间、VIX升破30。本周因感恩节缩短，市场将关注通胀数据，其结果可能影响对美联储12月9日会议加息的担忧。

body.en:
[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/20/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-nov-23-27-2026.html) reports the Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains on Friday, as neither Anthropic's IPO nor Nvidia's earnings revived the AI trade. The S&P 500's relative strength index dipped below 30, an oversold signal, and a cooler inflation print could soothe fears of a half-point Fed hike.

Risks still on the calendar include Jensen Huang's congressional hearings next month, a possible government shutdown and the Iran war. Markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.
body.zh:
据[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/20/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-nov-23-27-2026.html)报道，上周五纳指抹去今年全部涨幅，Anthropic上市和英伟达财报都未能提振AI板块。标普500相对强弱指数跌破30，显示超卖；若通胀数据低于预期，可能缓解市场对美联储加息50个基点的担忧。

后续风险包括黄仁勋下月的国会听证、可能的政府停摆以及伊朗战事。周四感恩节美股休市。

title.zh: 瑞士外长卡西斯11月23日至24日访华
title.en: Swiss foreign minister Cassis visits China Nov. 23–24

summary.zh: 外交部发言人22日宣布，应王毅邀请，瑞士联邦副主席兼外长卡西斯将于11月23日至24日访华，并举行中瑞第五轮外长级战略对话。
summary.en: China's foreign ministry said on the 22nd that Swiss Vice President and Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis will visit Nov. 23–24 at Wang Yi's invitation for the fifth China–Switzerland foreign-minister strategic dialogue.

sources.name: 中华人民共和国外交部

title.zh: 中加签署金融工作组工作规范，拟测试使用本币互换
title.en: China and Canada sign terms for financial working group, plan swap-line tests

summary.zh: 央行行长潘功胜与加拿大财长商鹏飞、加拿大央行行长麦克勒姆签署《中加金融工作组工作规范》，双方将测试使用续签的本币互换协议，探索扩大本币结算，并欢迎加方机构发行熊猫债。
summary.en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng signed terms of reference with Canada's finance minister and central bank governor. The sides will test the renewed currency swap, explore more local-currency use and welcome Canadian panda bonds.

body.zh: 据[新浪财经转CfetsOnline](https://finance.sina.com.cn/wm/2026-11-22/doc-inizqfik6210160.shtml)，金融工作组是今年1月中加领导人会晤联合声明的成果之一，首次会议于4月在北京举行。工作规范明确了参与部门、合作领域与交流方式，交流范围涵盖货币政策、金融监管、金融科技、反洗钱、跨境资金流动和全球金融治理等。加方还对中方有意在加拿大市场发行人民币绿色主权债券表示欢迎。

title.en: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4, its first flagship Loop Transformer model
title.zh: 智谱Z.ai发布GLM-5.4，首个基于循环Transformer的旗舰模型

summary.en: Z.ai says GLM-5.4 reruns a shared block of layers several times per pass, reaching intelligence comparable to 2T–3T-parameter models without adding parameters, and pitches it as the start of "Generalized Coding".
summary.zh: Z.ai称，GLM-5.4在一次前向计算中让一组共享权重的层循环执行多次，在不增加参数的情况下达到相当于2万亿至3万亿参数模型的水平，并称这标志着“泛化编程”的开端。

body.en:
In a Nov. 23 research post, Z.ai says it adapted an already pre-trained base model into a Loop Transformer through continued training at roughly 750B scale, rather than training a looped model from scratch, raising the capability ceiling at modest compute cost ([Z.ai](https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.4)).

The company argues that long-chain reasoning tasks such as large-scale software engineering, cybersecurity, 3D modeling and physical control benefit more from effective compute than from extra parameters. It acknowledges a limitation: the model tends to fall into overly long "marathon thinking" loops, though that extra reflection consistently improves accuracy.
body.zh:
Z.ai在11月23日的研究博文中表示，团队没有从零训练循环模型，而是通过继续训练，把一个已预训练好的约7500亿参数规模的基座模型改造成循环Transformer，以较小的算力开销抬高能力上限（[Z.ai](https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.4)）。

该公司认为，大规模软件工程、网络安全、3D建模和物理控制等超长链推理任务，更依赖有效算力而非更多参数。博文也承认，模型容易陷入过长的“马拉松式思考”循环，不过这种反复反思与自我纠错确实持续提升了准确率。

title.en: Amazon nears $7.5 billion deal for AI chip-software startup Decart
title.zh: 亚马逊接近以75亿美元收购AI芯片软件公司Decart

summary.en: Amazon is in final-stage talks to buy Israeli startup Decart, whose software optimizes AI workloads across chips including AWS's Trainium, for about $7.5 billion; a deal could come within days but may still fall through.
summary.zh: 亚马逊正就收购以色列初创公司Decart进行最后阶段谈判，作价约75亿美元。Decart的软件可在包括AWS自研Trainium在内的多种芯片上优化AI负载；交易最快几天内宣布，但仍可能告吹。

body.en: Reports citing the Financial Times say the deal would strengthen AWS's ability to make non-Nvidia accelerators easier to use for inference ([PYMNTS](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/amazon-nears-7-5-billion-purchase-of-ai-startup-decart/)). Decart was valued at about $4 billion earlier this year; nothing has been announced yet ([Ctech](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/uckadwd7r)).
body.zh: 援引《金融时报》的报道称，这笔交易将增强AWS让非英伟达加速器更易用于推理的能力（[PYMNTS](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/amazon-nears-7-5-billion-purchase-of-ai-startup-decart/)）。Decart今年早些时候估值约40亿美元，目前双方尚未正式宣布（[Ctech](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/uckadwd7r)）。

title.en: Trump says he may resume Iran strikes after New Year if talks fail
title.zh: 特朗普称若谈判无果，可能在新年后恢复对伊朗打击

summary.en: Trump told Fox News he is inclined to resume military strikes on Iran after the New Year if indirect talks don't produce a deal, and warned Iranian vessels testing the US naval blockade would be sunk. Tehran says Hormuz will be safe if its demands are met.
summary.zh: 特朗普对福克斯新闻表示，如果间接谈判无法达成协议，他倾向于在新年后恢复对伊朗的军事打击，并警告试图突破美国海上封锁的伊朗船只将被击沉。德黑兰则称，只要其要求得到满足，霍尔木兹海峡就会安全。

body.en:
Trump called Iranian negotiators "professional tap dancers" and said the talks were "all BS", while encouraging anti-government protesters in Iran to keep demonstrating, [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-nov-23-2026/4133974) reported. The remarks shift tone from his comments a day earlier about seeking a "permanent" deal.

Iran says safe passage could return if Washington meets conditions including sanctions relief and an end to the naval blockade ([ABC News](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-tehran-strait-hormuz-safe-demands/?id=138369648)).
body.zh:
据[阿纳多卢通讯社](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-nov-23-2026/4133974)报道，特朗普称伊朗谈判代表是“职业踢踏舞者”，说谈判“全是胡扯”，还鼓励伊朗反政府示威者继续抗议。这与他前一天称寻求“永久性”协议的口吻有所不同。

伊朗方面表示，如果美国满足解除制裁、结束海上封锁等条件，海峡通行安全即可恢复（[ABC新闻](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-tehran-strait-hormuz-safe-demands/?id=138369648)）。

title.en: Indonesia confirms 24 dead in candy factory fire, about 30 missing
title.zh: 印尼糖果厂大火已确认24人遇难，约30人失踪

summary.en: A fire that gutted the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Banten, on Saturday evening killed at least 24 people; rescuers are still searching for about 30 missing workers, and an air-conditioner short circuit is the preliminary suspected cause.
summary.zh: 周六晚，万丹省芝甘德的PT Fonusa Agung Mulia糖果厂发生大火，至少24人遇难，救援人员仍在搜寻约30名失踪工人。初步调查怀疑起火原因为空调短路。

body.en: About 300 people were at the complex for Saturday's shift, according to the parent company. Hotspots and an increasingly unstable structure are hampering rescuers; 29 people are confirmed safe. A presidential labour adviser said he would summon the factory's chief executive ([Al Jazeera/Reuters](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/indonesian-police-remove-24-body-bags-from-factory-fire-site)).
body.zh: 据母公司称，周六当班时厂区约有300人。残余火点和日益不稳的建筑结构阻碍了救援，目前已确认29人安全。总统劳工事务顾问表示将约谈工厂负责人（[半岛电视台/路透社](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/indonesian-police-remove-24-body-bags-from-factory-fire-site)）。

title.en: Libya's eastern government files UN complaint over Benghazi ship attacks
title.zh: 利比亚东部政府就班加西船只遇袭向联合国提出申诉

summary.en: Libya's eastern-based government asked the UN General Assembly and Security Council to investigate drone-boat attacks on Russian and Maltese ships off Benghazi, after Ukraine said it was responsible, and called on Kyiv to explain its military activities in Libya.
summary.zh: 在乌克兰称对袭击负责后，利比亚东部政府请求联合国大会和安理会调查班加西外海俄罗斯和马耳他船只遭无人艇袭击一事，并要求基辅就其在利比亚的军事活动作出解释。

title.en: Kospi sinks 3.3% despite rescue plan as Taiex rebounds
title.zh: 韩国救市方案未能止跌，KOSPI再挫3.3%，台股反弹

summary.en: South Korea's Kospi fell 3.31% to 4,708.54 on Monday, briefly triggering a program-trading halt, even after weekend stabilization measures. Taiwan's Taiex rose 2.16%, while Hong Kong slipped and Shanghai edged up.
summary.zh: 尽管周末出台稳市措施，韩国KOSPI周一仍下跌3.31%，收于4708.54点，盘中一度触发程序交易暂停。台湾加权指数上涨2.16%，港股小跌，沪指微涨。

body.en:
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261123006600320) reports the index opened 2.77% lower and fell as low as 4,586.80 as foreign investors turned net sellers; program trading was suspended for five minutes when the Kospi was down 5.11% around 11:33 a.m. The won also weakened against the dollar.

Across the region, [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-rates-technology-ai-anthropic-49ba1beba78fa4ed2bd5898029f79c91) said the Hang Seng fell 0.1% and Shanghai gained 0.2%, India's Sensex dropped 1.7%, and Tokyo was closed for a holiday, while US futures climbed.
body.zh:
据[韩联社](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261123006600320)报道，KOSPI低开2.77%，随着外资由净买入转为净卖出，盘中最低跌至4586.80点；上午11:33左右指数跌幅达5.11%，程序交易暂停5分钟。韩元兑美元同步走弱。

据[美联社](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-rates-technology-ai-anthropic-49ba1beba78fa4ed2bd5898029f79c91)报道，恒生指数跌0.1%，上证指数涨0.2%，印度Sensex跌1.7%，日本因假日休市，美股期货走高。

title.en: Anthropic and Nvidia shares rebound in premarket after tech rout
title.zh: 科技股暴跌后，Anthropic与英伟达盘前反弹

summary.en: After the Nasdaq slid 10% last week, Nvidia rose 8.6% and newly listed Anthropic 4.47% in Monday premarket trading; neoclouds Nebius, CoreWeave and Iren also gained around 9–11%.
summary.zh: 上周纳指下跌10%后，周一盘前英伟达上涨8.6%，新上市的Anthropic上涨4.47%；Nebius、CoreWeave和Iren等新兴云服务商也上涨约9%至11%。

body.en: Anthropic raised a record $93.5 billion in its IPO, plus $26 billion from tech giants buying at the offer price; it jumped 17% on Thursday's debut before closing 8.5% lower Friday. Nvidia had slumped more than 40% over the past month ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/anthropic-nvidia-shares.html)).
body.zh: Anthropic通过IPO募资创纪录的935亿美元，另有科技巨头以发行价认购260亿美元；该股周四上市首日上涨17%，周五收跌8.5%。英伟达股价过去一个月累计下跌逾40%（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/anthropic-nvidia-shares.html)）。

title.zh: 王毅与卡西斯在南京举行中瑞第五轮外长级战略对话
title.en: Wang Yi and Cassis hold fifth China–Switzerland strategic dialogue in Nanjing

summary.zh: 双方同意加快推进自贸协定升级议定书各自国内批约程序，深化金融、科技、知识产权、人工智能、通信技术和教育等领域合作，并就乌克兰危机等问题交换意见。
summary.en: The two sides agreed to speed domestic ratification of their upgraded free-trade agreement and deepen cooperation in finance, technology, IP, AI, telecoms and education, and exchanged views on Ukraine and other issues.

body.zh:
据[外交部](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/web/wjdt_674879/gjldrhd_674881/202611/t20261123_12065400.shtml)消息，王毅表示今年是中瑞建立创新战略伙伴关系10周年，希望瑞方以实际行动反对“台独”，并称中欧应跳出所谓“贸易不平衡”叙事陷阱，希望瑞方为中欧平稳解决经贸分歧发挥积极影响。

卡西斯表示，瑞方坚定恪守一个中国原则，愿同中方维护自由贸易、反对保护主义，加强人工智能全球治理。
body.en:
According to [China's foreign ministry](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/web/wjdt_674879/gjldrhd_674881/202611/t20261123_12065400.shtml), Wang marked the 10th anniversary of the two countries' innovative strategic partnership, urged Switzerland to oppose "Taiwan independence" in action, and said China and Europe should move beyond the "trade imbalance" narrative, asking Bern to help smooth EU–China trade disputes.

Cassis reaffirmed Switzerland's one-China principle and said it would work with China to uphold free trade, oppose protectionism and strengthen global AI governance.

sources.name: 中华人民共和国外交部

title.zh: 四部门发布“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案
title.en: Four ministries issue plan for elderly-care and childcare services

summary.zh: 国家发改委、民政部、国家卫健委、教育部联合印发方案，提出到2030年养老机构护理型床位占比达73%、社区养老设施覆盖率达70%，3岁以下婴幼儿入托率较2025年提高6个百分点。
summary.en: The NDRC and the civil affairs, health and education ministries set 2030 targets: 73% of beds in elderly-care institutions to be nursing beds, 70% community coverage of elderly-care facilities, and under-3 childcare enrollment up 6 points from 2025.

body.zh: 据[中国政府网](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202611/content_7087024.htm)，方案（发改社会〔2026〕1623号）于11月9日印发、23日公布，部署设施布局、医养结合、托育服务网络、普惠供给、科技赋能和监管保障等措施，推进“一刻钟托育服务圈”和老幼共托。

title.zh: 中石油集团副总经理谢军被查，辞任中国石油董事
title.en: CNPC deputy general manager Xie Jun under investigation, resigns PetroChina board seat

summary.zh: 中国石油天然气集团党组成员、副总经理谢军涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委审查调查；中国石油23日公告，谢军已辞去董事及投资与发展委员会委员职务。
summary.en: CNPC Party group member and deputy general manager Xie Jun is under investigation by the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations; PetroChina said on the 23rd he has resigned as a director and investment committee member.
